Name: TheDefective1's East Scarp (Juliet Only) Portraits
Author: TheDefective1
Description:
I figured out the naming issues that were causing Portraiture to skip over some of her portraits, back when I posted this the first time! [i](At least, the ones I've been able to test are working now.. I haven't done a full in-game year's worth of testing to actually check all of them, so [b]please [/b]let me know if you stumble across a set of portraits that aren't showing up where they should!)[/i] I also previously attempted to make a mod to try to get around that issue a different way, but some event outfits STILL weren't showing up right. I think I finally have it figured out now though! My apologies to anyone who downloaded that mod first, it was a bit of a mess as it was my first attempt at modding! 😅

[b]To use these portraits, just drag and drop the .PNG files into the portraits folder within the Portraiture mod folder[/b], [If you're in the right spot, the file location should look like this: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\mods\Portraiture\Portraits] and that's it!

[b]Once you're in game, go talk to Juliet and press 'P' until you see her portraits switch to this one! Then press 'O' to lock her onto that set of portraits, so that you can still change other NPCs portraits without changing hers too.[/b]

[u]This mod is also compatible with the standalone mod 'Juliet and Jessie the Joja Clerks' if you prefer that one over East Scarp, since the same naming rule applies no matter what with Portraiture- just ignore the requirement popup for East Scarp when downloading! [/u]My mod will have extra portraits in it, but those will automatically be skipped over if they're not needed.
